data.one_liner: Official Flutter integration for Highcharts interactive charts using WebViews.
data.what_it_does: Provides Flutter widgets wrapping the Highcharts library to render interactive charts across Android, iOS, and Web. Supports dynamic chart updates via refresh, custom JavaScript callbacks, and various Highcharts modules like Stock and Maps.
use_when: You need to embed Highcharts into a Flutter application.
You require complex chart types like Stock, Maps, or Ganttcharts.
You want cross-platform chart rendering including web support via WebViews.
avoid_when: You prefer a pure native Flutter rendering engine rather than a WebView-based chart implementation.
You need standard open-source licensing without specialized commercial tiers (Highcharts has specific licensing requirements).
strengths: Supports a wide range of advanced chart types and modules (Stock, Maps, Gantt, Heatmap)
Supports dynamic refreshing and JavaScript-based callbacks
weaknesses: Relies on WebViews underneath, which can introduce platform rendering and export limitations
Commercial licensing requirements may apply depending on usage
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package dependency. Example projects may require platform-specific targets like setting iOS deployment target to 15.0.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure Flutter chart library with native canvas rendering without WebView overhead.
